config.mccislandeventhelper.title: MCC Island Event Helper
config.mccislandeventhelper.general.enab:
Turns every feature on or off at once.

The settings in the event tabs only apply while this is on.
config.mccislandeventhelper.sea_monsters: Adds a colored heart after each fish on an Event Fish Order. The color shows where that fish is caught.
config.mccislandeventhelper.cursed_carni:
Shows which Carnival Activity starts next and how long until it does start.

Only visible in Lobbies and on Fishing Islands by default.
When enabled, the Activity countdown widget will always be visible.

Shows the current amount of Carnival Ticket Scrap you have.

Only visible in Lobbies or on Fishing Islands.

Shows the game icons of games that reward scrap that you're missing.

Only works when you have the 'Ticket Scrap tracker' setting enabled.
Load scrap counts from the API

Automatically load the amount of tickets you have from the API when joining the server.

Please note that this does make a request to 'stats.derniklaas.de' and requires the MCC Island 'Infinibag' API Setting to be turned on.
